## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| **No sound** | Monitoring settings / no file loaded | - Check that record arm (red circle) and input monitoring (speaker) are ON for the `scratch engine` track.<br>- Check that the JSFX window's waveform view shows a waveform (if it says "no sample", run the import).<br>- If `Untouched transport` is `Stop`, there is no sound while you are not touching the jog. |
| **The sound stops 0.15 s after the knob stops** | Touch mode setting | - With a touch sensor: set `Touch note` to the right note number (54 on the FLX4).<br>- Without a touch sensor: this is normal. To keep sounding while stopped, set `Auto release` to `0` (stop it with the `Release note` button). |
| **Pressing the jog does not scratch (touch does not work)** | The controller's jog mode | On controllers with a VINYL (scratch) mode switch, check that it is ON (when OFF, some controllers do not send the top touch, and the jog acts as a pitch nudge). If the JSFX's `touch` lamp lights when you press the top, the touch is arriving |
| **Silence after reaching the end** | End-of-sample setting | With `At end of sample` set to `Stop (silent)`, reaching the end with your hand off gives silence (if you are touching the jog, the last grain keeps sounding so you can pull back). To keep playing from the start, change it to `Loop to start`. |
| **The video window froze after a projector/monitor was switched off/on or unplugged** | REAPER's video window stopped drawing | Run `reascratch_video_reopen.lua` to reopen the video window (see [“Projector output”](projector-output.md)) |
| **The picture does not follow** | The sync script is not running | - Check that `reascratch_video_sync.lua` is running (it toggles, so running it again stops it; even with auto-sync chosen in setup, running it once by hand stops it).<br>- Check that the video window is open with `View` > `Video`. |
| **Opening `ReaScratch-HID-Bridge.exe` or a `.command` shows a warning and it will not start** | Windows / macOS block unsigned programs | See “If a warning stops it from starting” under [“HID controllers (NI Traktor Kontrol S4, S3, S2)”](controller-setup-and-midi-mapping.md#hid-controllers-ni-traktor-kontrol-s4-s3-s2) |
| **The crossfader and video effects show up late in the picture** | REAPER draws video ahead and buffers it | Right-click the video window → `Performance tweaks (experimental)` → `Video cache` → `All media and video FX are not cached`. It takes effect immediately (setup also tells you if it is not set) |
| **Video seeking is jerky** | Keyframes are far apart | The video is still compressed H.264 or similar. Convert it to MJPEG as described in [“Heavy video (all-intra conversion)”](heavy-video-all-intra-conversion.md). |
| **The sound drops out / crackles** | Too much load on the PC | Measure as described in [“Testing on a low-spec PC (load test)”](testing-on-a-low-spec-pc-load-test.md). A larger audio buffer, a smaller video height in setup, or closing other background software helps. |
| **The imported audio goes silent partway through** | An old version of the video sync script | A warning appears on import. An old version of the video sync script stopped playback while REAPER was rendering. Update the kit to the latest version and import the video again. |
| **Playback stops partway through the track / the waveform is cut off** | The track is too long | If the waveform view shows "only the first ○:○○ of ○:○○ loaded" in red, the track exceeds the length that can be loaded. Cut the video shorter and import it again. |
| **Turning the Reloop Buddy does nothing (Windows)** | The MIDI driver is not working | With the standard Windows driver, the Buddy's MIDI part (jog and buttons) does not start ("Code 10" in Device Manager). Install the "ASIO Driver" from the Reloop product page and reconnect the Buddy (how to check: below the table). No driver is needed on a Mac. |
| **With two decks, deck B's picture is not layered / breaks up when stopped / video effects do not work on B** | The project's video settings | This does not happen in projects made from the kit's template (`File` > `Project templates` > `ReaScratch`). In the current project, run `reascratch_setup.lua` again (it moves the `video B view` track to the place that suits the project's video settings; restarting the video sync does the same). If that does not help, close REAPER, open the project file (.rpp) in a text editor, delete the one line starting with `VIDEO_CONFIG`, save, and open it again (the cause is below the table). |
| **The JSFX cannot be found** | Files in the wrong place | Check that `Effects/ReaScratch/reascratch.jsfx` is inside the `Effects` folder of the REAPER resource folder (the folder opened by `Options` > `Show REAPER resource path in explorer/finder`). |

**Turning the Reloop Buddy does nothing**: Once `Reloop Buddy In` appears in REAPER's `Options` > `Preferences` > `Audio` > `MIDI Inputs`, it is ready.

**With two decks, deck B's picture is not layered** (cause): Depending on REAPER's video settings (`Video` in `Project settings`), the picture of an upper track covers the lower one. Setup and the video sync put `video B view` in the place that suits them, but when the tracks have been reordered by hand, for example, the `video B view` track's picture can be shown as is, hiding the processing that layers the two pictures (the Video processor on the `video` track).
